english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone thoughtfully considers other people's needs.
Choose 體貼 when the person shows care by noticing and responding to other people's needs.
Use this when the person's kindness specifically involves being considerate of other people's needs and feelings.
Use this when sensitive means considerate of other people's feelings rather than easily offended.

examples.english: It was really thoughtful of you to wait with me for the bus so late.
examples.traditional: 你咁夜仲陪我等車，真係好體貼。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 je6 zung6 pui4 ngo5 dang2 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tip3

examples.english: You’re so caring—you knew I was ill and even made congee for me.
examples.traditional: 你真係好體貼，知道我病咗仲特登煲粥畀我。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tip3 zi1 dou3 ngo5 beng6 zo2 zung6 dak6 dang1 bou1 zuk1 bei2 ngo5

examples.english: You’re really kind and tell me to rest early when you know I’m tired.
examples.traditional: 你真係好體貼，知道我攰就叫我早啲休息。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tip3 zi1 dou3 ngo5 gui6 zau6 giu3 ngo5 zou2 di1 jau1 sik1

examples.english: They are very sensitive to other people's feelings and offer to carry my bag when they see I am tired.
examples.traditional: 佢好體貼，見我攰就主動幫我拎袋。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 tai2 tip3 gin3 ngo5 gui6 zau6 zyu2 dung6 bong1 ngo5 ling1 doi2
